description: This file defines the EmailDao class responsible for database access related to Email and EmailTemplate entities, including methods to retrieve email by name and match email templates based on various criteria.

classes.name: EmailDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Email-related database operations, extending BaseDao.

methods.name: getEmailByName
methods.description: Retrieves an Email entity by its name.

methods.name: getEmailTemplateMatches
methods.description: Fetches email templates matching the specified email name, locale, recipient role, and performer role, considering null values for roles.
